flaw_1_sonar_clearance_geometry.name: False Corner Clearance Averaging
flaw_1_sonar_clearance_geometry.symptom: Organism failed to detect straight forward wall obstacles when peripheral rays grazed open edges
flaw_1_sonar_clearance_geometry.impact: Eliminated premature breakout into perpendicular obstacles

flaw_2_s_curve_motor_kinetics.name: Motor Rate Limit vs Recovery Phase Timing Discrepancy
flaw_2_s_curve_motor_kinetics.symptom: Wheel actuators require ~15 ticks under jerk filter (j_max=30 rad/s^3) to reach commanded velocity, but recovery phase timers expired in 10-14 ticks
flaw_2_s_curve_motor_kinetics.repaired_logic: Matched phase timing and dynamic breakout displacement to physical motor acceleration kinetics
flaw_2_s_curve_motor_kinetics.impact: Allowed sufficient time for physical robot mass to achieve escape velocity

flaw_3_directional_spin_alignment.name: Spin Azimuth Premature Exit & Directional Alignment
flaw_3_directional_spin_alignment.symptom: Tier 2 spin terminated before aligning direct front ray with true open avenue (>1.0m), causing breakout into sidewalls in 0.75m corridors and dead ends
flaw_3_directional_spin_alignment.repaired_logic: Increased spin velocity to 7.0 rad/s and enforced ray alignment (best_ray_idx in [6,7,8]) with true open exit avenue
flaw_3_directional_spin_alignment.impact: Ensured clean single-cycle 180-deg turnaround within 18 ticks

flaw_4_stuck_detector_latency_and_frame.name: Stuck Detector Latency, Speed Gating & Breakout Reference Frame
flaw_4_stuck_detector_latency_and_frame.symptom: 20-tick rolling window delayed stuck confirmation by ~32 ticks; measuring breakout displacement from pre-reverse origin caused zero-crossing aborts; lack of speed gate caused false candidate triggers during active turns
flaw_4_stuck_detector_latency_and_frame.repaired_logic: Implemented dynamic 10-tick window, speed gating (speed < 0.05m/s for candidate accumulation), and tracked breakout_origin separately
flaw_4_stuck_detector_latency_and_frame.impact: Prompt stuck detection (0.26s) and zero false stuck triggers during active turns
